title: MM-Net: A Multimodal Multi-Task Network for Sleep Staging and Sleep Apnea Assessment After Ischemic Stroke
abstract: arXiv:2610.36583v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated polysomnography after ischemic stroke is challenging because of altered sleep-related neural activity and concurrent respiratory disturbances. Existing stroke-specific approaches mainly address sleep-stage classification, leaving joint analysis of sleep architecture and respiratory events underexplored. Moreover, adapting pretrained EEG encoders introduces a representation inconsistency when downstream models are trained on embeddings from previously seen patients but evaluated on unseen individuals. We propose MM-Net, a multimodal multi-task framework that resolves this inconsistency through cross-fitting and ridge-based embedding alignment. Sleep-adapted EEG-EOG representations and engineered neural descriptors are fused with learned cardiorespiratory features through cross-attention and shared temporal modeling for simultaneous sleep staging and respiratory-event detection. translated_title: MM-Net：用于缺血性卒中后睡眠分期与睡眠呼吸暂停评估的多模态多任务网络
translated_abstract: 缺血性卒中后的自动多导睡眠图分析面临挑战，其原因在于睡眠相关神经活动的改变以及并发的呼吸障碍。现有的针对卒中的方法主要解决睡眠分期分类问题，而对睡眠结构和呼吸事件的联合分析尚未得到充分探索。此外，在适配预训练EEG编码器时，当下游模型在已见患者的嵌入上训练、却在未见过的个体上进行评估时，会引入表征不一致问题。我们提出了MM-Net，这是一个多模态多任务框架，通过交叉拟合和基于岭回归的嵌入对齐来解决这种不一致性。睡眠适应的EEG-EOG表征和工程化神经描述符通过交叉注意力与共享时间建模和学习到的心肺特征相融合，从而同时实现睡眠分期和呼吸事件检测。在iSLEEPS数据集（99名亚急性缺血性卒中患者）上……
tldr: 提出多模态多任务网络MM-Net，通过交叉拟合和基于岭回归的嵌入对齐解决表征不一致问题，利用交叉注意力融合EEG-EOG表征、神经描述符与心肺特征，实现缺血性卒中后睡眠分期与呼吸事件检测的同步联合评估。
en_tdlr: MM-Net, a multimodal multi-task network that resolves representation inconsistency via cross-fitting and ridge-based embedding alignment, fuses sleep-adapted EEG-EOG representations and neural descriptors with cardiorespiratory features through cross-attention to enable simultaneous sleep staging and respiratory event detection after ischemic stroke.
